title: A new category is priced for every tier from the start
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click New Category.
  3. Type a name no other category uses.
  4. Click Create Category.
  5. Open Settings › Categories.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories list shows.

Step 2:

  • The New Category page opens.

Step 3:

  • The name shows in the field.

Step 4:

  • The category is created and its page shows the General Matrix's grid.

Step 5:

  • The new category's row shows General Matrix in Pricing Matrix.
  • Its Default cell and every tier cell, tier A's included, show a rule or "Uses previous tier"; no cell is empty.
